rule: Sky-cats molt feathers to the cliff base
texts: Each Keeper stores the collected feathers in a bin at the Watch.

fields.sentence: Each Keeper stores the collected feathers in a bin at the Watch.
parse: (: each_keeper_stores (Implication (Member $x keeper) (And (Member (sk_store $x) store) (Agent (sk_store $x) $x) (Theme (sk_store $x) sk_feathers_1) (Member (sk_bin $x) bin) (Location (sk_store $x) (sk_bin $x)) (LocatedIn (sk_bin $x) sk_watch_1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: "the Watch" correctly stays a capitalized-common-noun witness with no Name atom, the descriptive participial modifier "collected" distributes over the definite plural's members rather than fusing, and the dependent indefinite "a bin" is the Skolem function (sk_bin $x) with its LocatedIn inside the conclusion.
